title: SocialDriveGen: generating diverse traffic scenarios with controllable social interactions

control_signal.value: Natural-language adversarial proposals per vehicle pair from a VLM, turned into reward functions; plus two social-reward parameters (angle phi for egoism/altruism, magnitude lambda for social-constraint weight).

control_mechanism.value: Gradient-free evolutionary guidance at every denoising step: population of noisy trajectories scored by predicted clean-trajectory reward, resampled by a reward-weighted elite distribution with annealed temperature.

base_model.value: Multi-agent adaptation of an evolutionary-strategy-guided diffusion model (Diffusion-ES style) jointly generating all vehicles' trajectories, with VLM scene analysis and LLM reward construction on top.

datasets.value: Argoverse 2 only, real recordings used as the foundation for generated scenarios.

metrics.value: Engagement Ratio (share of scenarios with TTC under 4.0 s threshold), maximum relative velocity, maximum acceleration, extrinsic reward. No distribution-realism metric shown in packet.

controllability_evidence.value: Table 1: full method reaches Engagement Ratio 67.27% vs 50.91% single-stage VLM and 60.00% Diffusion-ES. Prosocial phi=pi/4 lowers Engagement Ratio by 5.40%; lowering lambda from 1.0 to 0.3 raises extrinsic reward by +86.49%.

notes: Hybrid: LLM/VLM-driven proposal layer feeding reward-guided diffusion sampling; family chosen as inference-time guidance since the trained diffusion model is steered at sampling. Packet shows no realism metrics or limitations section.
